identity.name: Datejust
identity.one_liner: The five-digit sapphire Datejust 36 of 1988-2006 with caliber 3135.

narrative.story: The 16234 modernized the Datejust with a sapphire crystal and the caliber 3135 while keeping the 36mm case and fluted white-gold bezel. Produced in large numbers for nearly two decades, it is the workhorse neo-vintage Datejust — the reference most people's inherited Rolex turns out to be.
narrative.collector_notes: Enormous dial variety, from silver sticks to Roman numerals to Tapestry dials. Hollow-link Jubilee bracelets stretch — check bracelet condition before agreeing a price.
